fields.description: Detects possible DLL hijacking of epnsm.dll by looking for suspicious image loads, loading this DLL from unexpected locations.
fields.name: Possible DLL Hijacking of epnsm.dll
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (module.path contains "\\epnsm.dll" and (not (module.path contains "c:\\program files\\Epson Software\\Document Capture Server\\" or module.path contains "c:\\program files (x86)\\Epson Software\\Document Capture Server\\" or module.path contains "c:\\program files\\Epson Software\\Event Manager\\" or module.path contains "c:\\program files (x86)\\Epson Software\\Event Manager\\"))))
